    try:
        # 総メモリを取得
        total_memory_command = [
            "powershell",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-NonInteractive",
            "-Command",
            "Get-CimInstance -Class Win32_OperatingSystem | Select TotalVisibleMemorySize"
        ]
        import subprocess
        total_memory_process = subprocess.Popen(total_memory_command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        total_memory_output, total_memory_error = total_memory_process.communicate()

        # 使用済みメモリを取得
        used_memory_command = [
            "powershell",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-NonInteractive",
            "-Command",
            "Get-CimInstance -Class Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Memory | Select CommittedBytes"
        ]
        used_memory_process = subprocess.Popen(used_memory_command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        used_memory_output, used_memory_error = used_memory_process.communicate()
        used_memory_output = used_memory_output.decode('utf-8').split('\n')
        used_memory = int(used_memory_output[1].split(':')[1].strip())

        # メモリ使用率を計算
        memory_usage = (used_memory / total_memory) * 100

        return {
            "status": memory_usage
        }

    except Exception as e:
        return {
            "status": "未実装"
